name: TFP Group Berhad
overview: TFP Group Berhad 今年推进收购 VSure Tech 并拟进行业务多元化，同时通过私下配售和发行凭单筹资；公司财政年度结算日由 6 月 30 日改为 12 月 31 日，并完成公司名称变更。收购事项因条件先决未满足而多次延长截止日期，尚未完成。
overview_en: TFP Group Berhad progressed its proposed acquisition of VSure Tech and proposed diversification during the year, alongside private placements and a bonus issue of warrants; the company changed its financial year end from 30 June to 31 December and completed a change of company name. The acquisition has not completed, with cut-off dates for conditions precedent extended multiple times.

segments.name: 金融科技
segments.note: 今年推进收购 VSure Tech 并拟进行业务多元化，收购尚未完成。
segments.note_en: The company progressed the proposed acquisition of VSure Tech and proposed diversification; the acquisition has not completed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 修改股份买卖协议条件先决。
actions.text_en: Modified a condition precedent under the SSA to exclude two minority shareholders holding approximately 1.47% of VSure Tech.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 将股份买卖协议条件先决截止日期由 2026 年 9 月 7 日延长 2 个月至 2026 年 11 月 7 日。
actions.text_en: Extended the cut-off date for conditions precedent under the SSA by 2 months from 7 September 2026 to 7 November 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 签署补充协议，将盈利保证期改为 FYE 31 December 2027 及 FYE 31 December 2028，并变更 VSure Tech 财政年度结算日至 12 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: Entered a supplemental letter to vary the profit guarantee period to FYE 31 December 2027 and FYE 31 December 2028, and to change VSure Tech's financial year end to 31 December.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 6 月 29 日批准上市 200,000,000 股代价股份及 583,471,945 张凭单。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved on 29 June 2026 the listing of 200,000,000 consideration shares and 583,471,945 warrants.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成公司名称变更、财政年度结算日变更，并进行私下配售及凭单发行等企业活动。
segments.note_en: The company completed a change of name and a change of financial year end, and undertook private placements and a bonus issue of warrants.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 凭单 C 行使价定为每张 RM0.0350，并签署构成凭单的信托契约。
actions.text_en: Fixed the exercise price of Warrant C at RM0.0350 each and executed the deed poll constituting the warrants.

actions.title: Change of Company Name - TFP GROUP BERHAD
actions.text: 公司名称由 TFP Solutions Berhad 变更为 TFP Group Berhad。
actions.text_en: Changed company name from TFP Solutions Berhad to TFP Group Berhad.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售第三批次发行价定为每股 RM0.0424。
actions.text_en: Fixed the issue price for the third tranche of the private placement at RM0.0424 per share.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售第二批次发行价定为每股 RM0.02。
actions.text_en: Fixed the issue price for the second tranche of the private placement at RM0.02 per share.

actions.title: Change in Financial Year End
actions.text: 财政年度结算日由 6 月 30 日改为 12 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: Changed financial year end from 30 June to 31 December.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售第一批次发行价定为每股 RM0.02。
actions.text_en: Fixed the issue price for the first tranche of the private placement at RM0.02 per share.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 拟将业务扩展至新领域。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed acquisition of VSure Tech and proposed diversification, intending to expand into new business areas.
